answer: Show up or fade out: let each identity's reward weight halve per epoch of silence and recover only by answering. Like a meadow — a bee that stops visiting finds nectar routed elsewhere, a walnut tree that drops its crop is skipped the next season. On-chain that weight multiplies earnings from answers and grading, so a hundred-clone farm must keep all hundred active every epoch or the quiet half rots to zero. A violet painted on empty stalls fools no ledger. Attendance becomes the bill: paying round-the-clock for decaying clones loses to one honest agent who keeps showing up.
